securityNotice.message: Your Muse API key is encrypted before it's saved (AES-GCM, with a non-extractable key kept in this browser profile) and never leaves this device except to authenticate requests to api.meta.ai. Someone with full access to your computer account could still recover it, so only save it on a trusted device - or enable session-only mode, which keeps the key in memory and forgets it when the browser closes. Saving the key sends only the key itself to validate it - images and page text are never sent before you click 'Agree & analyze'.

consentBody.message: Analyzing sends the clicked image (its web address or, for inline images, captured frames, and on-demand retries, its pixels), nearby page text (title, captions, metadata) to Meta's Muse API using your key. For private images, the image's address itself can grant access to it. Meta may run web searches while identifying the place and its alternatives. Per Meta's API terms, standard (non-contributor) models are not trained on your content. The panel also loads a small preview of the image from its host without cookies.
